verses.translation: By the fig and the olive ˹of Jerusalem˺

verses.arabicText: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Laqad khalaqnā l-insāna fī aḥsani taqwīmin
verses.translation: Indeed, We created humans in the best form
But We will reduce them to the lowest of the low ˹in Hell˺

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū ṣ-ṣāliḥāti falahum ajrun ghayru mamnūnin
verses.translation: except those who believe and do good—they will have a never-ending reward
Now, what makes you deny the ˹final˺ Judgment
Is Allah not the most just of all judges
